```{r}
#| label: fig-inhospdeath
#| fig-cap: "Association between in-hospital death and bilirubin (unadjusted)"

mod <- glm(death_baseline_C ~ ns(Bili_mgdL),
  data = escdata, family = binomial(link = "logit"),
)

tp <- termplot(mod, se = TRUE, plot = F, terms = 1)

# OR = 1 at median https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/survival/vignettes/splines.pdf
# med <- quantile(data %>% pull(sos_timeprevhosphf), na.rm = T, p = 0.5)
# med <- 0 # use 0 days instead

plotdata <- tp$Bili_mgdL

center <- with(plotdata, y[x == 1])

xlims <- seq(0, 5, 1)
ylims <- log(c(.7, .8, 0.9, 1, 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.4, 1.5))

plotdata <- plotdata %>%
  mutate(
    or = y - center,
    lci = y - global_z05 * se - center,
    uci = y + global_z05 * se - center,
    # or = y ,
    # lci = y - global_z05 * se,
    # uci = y + global_z05 * se,
    lci = if_else(lci < min(ylims), min(ylims), lci),
    uci = if_else(uci > max(ylims), max(ylims), uci)
  )

if (!is.null(ylims) & !is.null(xlims)) {
  if (any(plotdata$or[plotdata$x <= max(xlims)] > max(ylims)) |
    any(plotdata$or[plotdata$x <= max(xlims)] < min(ylims))) {
    stop("OR is smaller or larger than ylims")
  }
}

p <- ggplot(plotdata, aes(x = x, y = or)) +
  # geom_hline(yintercept = log(1), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = 2, color = "black", linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5, color = global_cols[1]) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lci, ymax = uci), fill = global_cols[1], alpha = 0.3, linetype = 0) +
  geom_rug(sides = "b") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      color = "lightgrey",
      linewidth = 0.5,
      linetype = 2
    ),
    text = element_text(size = 22, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Bilirubin (mg/dL)", y = "Odds Ratio (95% CI)") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = xlims,
    limits = c(min(xlims), max(xlims))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = ylims,
    limits = c(min(ylims), max(ylims)),
    labels = exp(ylims)
  )

if (output) {
  create_pptx(p)
}
p
```
